answer: Reputation follows an exponential temporal half-life, so influence fades unless sustained honest service earns reciprocal, corroborated trust. A freshly spawned identity is a low-weight vertex: without trusted incoming paths, its EigenTrust eigenvector centrality remains near zero, and a sybil oasis cannot amplify itself into consensus. Cosmetic signals, such as a changed pigment, do not alter that graph evidence.
